description: Plan what happens to your digital life when you die — accounts, photos, passwords, money, and social profiles — so someone you trust can actually find, access, memorialize, or close them without a legal nightmare. Use when someone says 'what happens to my accounts when I die', 'digital legacy', 'help my family access my stuff if something happens', or is doing estate planning and forgot the online half. Not legal advice — pairs with a real will.
